about_page_1: 👋 Hi! I'm the Voenmeh Timetable Bot. My main task is to make access to the schedule as fast and convenient as possible. I was developed by @ilyan_vas. By the way, the project has its own home — the channel Auditorium 404 | Voenmeh. There you'll be the first to know about updates, plans and will be able to influence the development. Subscribe! And now let me show you what I can do! You can go to the main menu with the /start command.
about_page_2: ✅ Current schedule always at hand The main screen shows the schedule for the selected day. And at the top you will see a dynamic header that will tell you when the next lesson starts or when the break ends. You can go to the main menu with the /start command.
about_page_3: 🔍 Smart Search Don't know where the teacher is or if the classroom you need is free? Use the search function! I can find the schedule for any teacher or classroom on the selected day. You can go to the main menu with the /start command.
about_page_4: 🔔 Flexible Notifications I can send you: • Summary for tomorrow (in the evening) • Summary for today (in the morning) • Reminders for the first lesson and at the beginning of each break. All this is configured in the «⚙️ Settings» menu. You can go to the main menu with the /start command.
about_page_5: 📲 Inline mode «Share schedule» In any dialogue (group chat, stream chat or just friends) just write my name and a request, for example: @bstu_timetable_bot O735B tomorrow I will immediately offer to send a ready-made schedule. Perfect for coordination with classmates! You can go to the main menu with the /start command.
